A Letter

To My Dearest Chengxuan

Two years ago today, I made the best decision of my life. I said "I do" to the woman who holds my heart, and every day since has been a gift.

两年前的今天，我做出了人生中最正确的决定。

You are my partner, my confidante, my greatest adventure. From the quiet mornings to the late-night conversations, from building a home together to dreaming about tomorrow — everything is better because you're in it.

你是我最好的伴侣，是我所有冒险的同行者。

Thank you for two years of love, laughter, and growing together. Here's to us — to everything we've built and everything still ahead.

谢谢你两年的陪伴与爱。愿我们的未来，比今天更美好。

Forever yours,
Stan ∞
